invariants: Fresh Session activation requires actual Agent and persistence providers, materializes even empty histories and rolls back failed or closed publication; no Agent=None success.
List exposes only inactive top-level persisted Sessions, newest createdAt first with UTF-8 byte id tie-break, strict canonical base64url keyset cursors and a positive safe-integer page limit.
Resume checks bridge/live/activating identity and exact workspace before Agent composition, reserves admission across awaits and releases failed activation for retry.
Concurrent close shares one cancellation/quiescence/descendant/flush/dispose operation; closing records reject new prompts and are removed even on explicit close failure.
Bridge unload cancels every captured Session before awaiting drains, disposes all owned Agents, clears exact records and reports aggregated teardown failures rather than swallowing them.
open_questions: ACP stdio/MCP/configuration/ordered semantic output are separate remaining provider/consumer closures; this contract does not certify those capabilities.
Review rc.1 provider/consumer changes and obtain new acceptance; alpha observations cannot certify this revision.
identity: Exact owned Agent/Session, opaque Session id, activation reservation and canonical cursor ordering key; active foreign Sessions cannot be resumed or listed.
ownership: ACP owns admission records and memoized close operations; services own Agent construction and durable storage, and descendant teardown is requested through the optional subagents service.
ordering: Validate, reserve, restore/create, guard lifetime, materialize fresh storage, publish; close cancels all activity before quiescence, descendant drain, persistence flush and Agent disposal.
errors: Invalid workspace/cursor/id/admission fail without publication; provider or close failures preserve diagnostics, release exact records and do not leave occupied resume reservations.
cancellation: Pre-aborted activation never calls providers; factory receives the request signal, late closed activation is disposed and cannot publish; unload cancellation is issued before any Session drain can block.
adaptation: Python 3.8.10 provider/handler lifecycle, JSONL/SQLite and canonical profile tests. No complete ACP wire, MCP, model/config controls, ordered updates or Win7 certification is inferred.

rc1_review.scope: The revised executable corpus and current Source inputs define bounded acceptance; historical alpha reviews remain historical.
